subject: commonfactorGWAS error: " argument 2 matches multiple formal arguments"

messages.author: c27e1b97e3e23447
messages.subject: commonfactorGWAS error: " argument 2 matches multiple formal arguments"
parts:
Hi everyone! Thanks for your help and support in the use of this package!

I'm trying to use the "commonfactorGWAS" to combine the FUSION summary statistics and LDSC output and run the common factor T-SEM... but I'm having weird results and this error...

> gfactor_TSEM_Hypothalamus<- commonfactorGWAS(covstruc= gfactor_LDSCoutput, SNP=gfactor_genes_Hypothalamus, parallel=FALSE, TWAS=TRUE)

Error in commonfactorGWAS(covstruc = gfactor_LDSCoutput, SNP = gfactor_genes_Hypothalamus,  :
  argument 2 matches multiple formal arguments

Any idea of what could it be?
Thanks in advace!

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: commonfactorGWAS error: " argument 2 matches multiple formal arguments"
parts: I think it's that your second argument is called SNP, but it should be called SNPs (with an s).
